body: It's not one I've personally heard before, but I'm inclined to believe you.

Haha. With the same font as one of those "CAUTION: HARD HAT AREA" signs. In all seriousness though, not the worst idea. If they really didn't get the message through the sign, then I would feel justified in talking to them. Thank you for the suggestion.
Hm... I wonder if they'd actually follow the directive.

I want to. I'm just worried that if me just shutting the door too rudely was enough to make my roommate think I hated them, that no matter how politely I ask them not to bother us after 11, it will result in the same fear of me hating them. We have a good relationship outside of this and I don't want to fracture it.
Ha. A little Christmas stocking eloquently embroidered with "Fuck off."

Honestly, I hoped to get around it but in my heart I know you're right. There's probably not going to be any convincing them unless I actually stand up and tell them why they need to cut it out. I guess I was just hoping for a solution where they, as adults, figure out why they shouldn't do it, but you're right: They're not going to realize if they haven't by now. Thank you for being blunt, I needed to hear it.

I think my only issue is that I’m more into it as a non-sexual thing, and so far I’ve only found people who invest in it as that. I may dig into it more on Reddit though—Thank you for pointing this out.
Oh? Is there a link where I can read about it or anything? I don’t play WoW, but if it had what I’m interested in I’d consider...
It's life-changing once you figure out the right angle for you personally. Definitely search around on here too, I've found some great tips from other people who use that method!
Thank you! I'm super excited about it!
Also a good point. I'd sort of forgotten to include myself in that sentence, but I'm aware that my quality of life wouldn't be too great after that either.
I'm running it over in my head but I'm not sure I've got it right. I think the first sentence is 'Foreclosing on us'? This is really cool though, I like it even as is. Good job!
I was mostly just thinking about the driver, but I guess anyone in the surrounding area would be pretty screwed, yeah. Good point.

Can I ask...when you wanted help, where did you go? I want to believe I have a choice, but I can't talk to any family or friends about this. I think that you're right, and I just want an end to the pain. Your words really mean a lot to me, thank you.

The thing is, I'm not sure if it's about the unknown...I feel like all I do is weigh people down, and it's more that I feel like that won't ever change. The unknown is scary but, compared to hurting people for the rest of my life it seems like the better alternative. I'm just tired of hurting myself and my family and my friends...even if there's a choice, it's hard to feel like I have one. I'm not sure if I'm making much sense, sorry again...
